request: Reduce the app size while retaining all functionality

measurement.scope: Sum of regular files in the same unsigned arm64 Release .app built with Xcode 26.2. Not the final App Store download or installed size.
measurement.business_binary_comparison: Every bundled file except Assets.car is SHA-256 identical; no files added or removed. This includes the app executable, MobileVLCKit, both extensions, localization tables, scripts and tracker data.
measurement.other_renditions: Non-illustration renditions retain their catalog identities and digests except generated legacy Icon Image digest values. Icon source files, layered icon stacks and vector renditions are unchanged; no App icon source was modified.

implementation.encoding: PNG, sRGB, original alpha channel; Asset Catalog default lossless deepmap2
implementation.originals: Unmodified image data remains in Git before this change and /tmp/soulo-app-size-20261115/lossless.xcassets/
implementation.runtime_behavior: No new loaders, libraries, network access or startup work; ToolIllustration layout and feature logic are unchanged.

quality.method: Compare source and packaged catalog output at the actual 3x display width, composited on black and white sRGB backgrounds. Also visually inspect About and Quick Actions output.
quality.other_candidates: Native HEVC/GPU lossy variants were rejected after transparency-edge differences. Normalizing invisible RGB values produced identical compiled catalog data and no size reduction.

verification.scope: All 11 illustration assets load through UIKit and render at 3x; iOS 26.2 Simulator
All 11 assets and minimum deployment compatibility; iOS 16.0 Simulator
50-language strict localization check, generated App Store metadata check and whitespace check

distribution: No push, website deployment or TestFlight upload was performed for this size optimization.
verification_notes: Initial preparation attempts with an incomplete XCTest injector environment were not counted as passing tests. Completed iOS 26.2 and iOS 16.0 runs both report TEST EXECUTE SUCCEEDED.
The iOS 16 run uses the same illustration files and ToolIllustration implementation in an isolated minimum-OS QA source copy; no physical device was operated.
